div.div:
LEGEND & LAYERS
• Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word / special transition · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

text.tspan: • Black solid (2.5 px): primary compass/passage movement (double arrowhead = two-way)
• Blue solid (2.8 px): vertical UPWAR / DOWN shaft (distinct from compass N/S)
• Purple dashed: magic word / special transition · Local markers: yellow = cross-page · orange = transient · red = death
• Optional layer [Parser Aliases / Fast Travel] (hidden by default): non-adjacent keyword shortcuts

div.div:
LOC_EASTEND — at east end of Twopit RoomYou are at the east end of the Twopit Room. The floor here is
littered with thin rock slabs, which make it easy to descend the pits.
There is a path here bypassing the pits to connect passages from east
and west. There are holes all over, but the only big one is on the
wall directly over the west pit where you can't get to it.
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. EAST → LOC_SWISSCHEESE [Ch 05]
2. WEST, ACROS → LOC_WESTEND
3. DOWN, PIT → LOC_EASTPIT

littered with thin rock slabs, which make it easy to descend
There is a path here bypassing the pits to connect passages
and west. There are holes all over, but the only big one is on
wall directly over the west pit where you can't get to it.

lamp to show it. Cavernous passages lead east, north, and south. On
the west wall is scrawled the inscription, "FEE FIE FOE FOO" [sic].
EXITS (source precedence order)
1. SOUTH → LOC_NARROW
2. EAST → LOC_CAVEIN
3. NORTH → LOC_IMMENSE
